auth.token_lifetime: Access token session-timeout based (UNVERIFIED exact; org policy)
auth.refresh: refresh_token grant until revoked or policy expires it

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Salesforce Partner Program (only for AppExchange listing)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: AppExchange security review only for listed apps (UNVERIFIED, page not fetched). Per search: from Spring '26 creation of new Connected Apps is disabled by default in all orgs; use External Client Apps (ECA, PKCE OAuth); temporary exception via Support, to be removed.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Org admin installs our External Client App / authorizes it (or approves the OAuth app), assigns permission set, and the user logs in and allows. API access requires Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance, Developer edition, or Professional with API add-on.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Immediate for private use; AppExchange security review UNVERIFIED

sandbox.how_to_get: Free Developer Edition org at developer.salesforce.com (self-serve)

rate_limits: Enterprise/Professional(with API): 100,000 + 1,000 per user license per 24 hours; Unlimited/Performance: 100,000 + 5,000 per license, plus add-ons (via search snippet of Salesforce limits cheat sheet)
incremental_sync: SOQL WHERE SystemModstamp > last sync; getUpdated/getDeleted; Bulk API 2.0 for backfill; Change Data Capture for streams
blockers: Customer edition must include API access; Professional needs an API add-on purchase (customer side).
New Connected Apps disabled by default since Spring '26; must build an External Client App.
Daily API call allocation shared with customer's other integrations; backfill via Bulk API.
sources: WebSearch result: 'Starting with Salesforce's Spring '26 release, creation of new Connected Apps is disabled by default in all orgs' (striim.com and rudderstack.com pages summarizing); developer.salesforce.com page itself returned 403 to WebFetch
https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/salesforce-app-limits-cheatsheet/guide/salesforce-app-limits-platform-api.html - search snippet: 100,000 plus licenses times calls per license
